<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916782_theRebbe_480" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916782_theRebbe_480__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The luminary's revelation in every place does not affect the place, and for it to manifest as a revealed action in the world, the mention of God's name must relate to worldly matters, as explained through the Baal Shem Tov's teaching that Israel's praises are the sustenance of the Holy One, blessed be He.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, this—that the luminary is in revelation in every place—</t>
    <t s="2">is in a manner that does not affect the place</t>
    <t s="3">(and only a general knowledge that there is a God),</t>
    <t s="4">because every action is through light and revelation50,</t>
    <t s="5">but not so this—that the luminary is in revelation</t>
    <t s="6">[for this—that the luminary is in revelation—is not the matter of revelation51],</t>
    <t s="7">does not affect the place.</t>
    <t s="8">And in order for this to be in a manner of revealed action in the world,</t>
    <t s="9">it is through the mention of the name of Heaven</t>
    <t s="10">[which comes from the aspect that the luminary is in revelation]</t>
    <t s="11">being related to the matters of the world.</t>
    <t s="12">And one can connect this with the well-known story52</t>
    <t s="13">of the Alter Rebbe, who heard from his teacher, the Maggid, about the greatness of the effort of the Baal Shem Tov that Israel</t>
    <t s="14">(men, women, and children)</t>
    <t s="15">should say words of praise to the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="16">[such as "Baruch Hashem,"</t>
    <t s="17">"Gelobt Hashem," and the like]</t>
    <t s="18">for His providing them with health and sustenance,</t>
    <t s="19">saying that the praises of Israel are the sustenance of the Holy One, blessed be He, as it were,</t>
    <t s="20">as it is written53</t>
    <t s="21">"And You are holy, enthroned upon the praises of Israel,"</t>
    <t s="22">that the sustenance of "And You are holy"</t>
    <t s="23">(upon which He sits, as it were)</t>
    <t s="24">is the praises of Israel,</t>
    <t s="25">that Israel praise and laud Him, blessed be He, for His providing them with children, life, and ample sustenance.</t>
    <t s="26">And the Alter Rebbe explained54</t>
    <t s="27">that it is like the matter in the Midrash on the verse55</t>
    <t s="28">"I adjure you, my companion,"</t>
    <t s="29">"My sustenance is that they shepherd Me with two daily offerings."</t>
    <t s="30">And according to the well-known explanation56</t>
    <t s="31">of the Sages' statement57</t>
    <t s="32">"Israel sustains their Father in Heaven,"</t>
    <t s="33">that just as sustenance in its simple sense is that through it a connection of the soul with the body is made, so too is the sustenance above, whose matter is the drawing down and enclothing of Ein Sof in the Sefiros, which are called by the name "body,"</t>
    <t s="34">it is understood</t>
    <t s="35">that this—that the sustenance of "And You are holy" is the praises of Israel—</t>
    <t s="36">is that through the praises of Israel, the drawing down of Ein Sof into the Sefiros is effected,</t>
    <t s="37">and through them—into the influences that the Holy One, blessed be He, bestows upon Israel through the Sefiros,</t>
    <t s="38">and in particular—into those influences for which Israel praises Him, blessed be He, for having bestowed these influences upon them.</t>
    <t s="39">For the influences as they are in themselves</t>
    <t s="40">(before the service of the praises of Israel),</t>
    <t s="41">are drawn down through the Sefiros, which are incomparable relative to Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="42">and through Israel praising Him, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="43">the Essence</t>
    <t s="44">[for their intention in this when they say "Baruch Hashem,"</t>
    <t s="45">"Gelobt Hashem," and the like, is to His Essence, blessed be He],</t>
    <t s="46">for His having bestowed the influences upon them,</t>
    <t s="47">through this the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof is drawn down into these influences.</t>
    <t s="48">And based on this, one will understand what is said in the teaching of the Baal Shem Tov</t>
    <t s="49">(mentioned above)</t>
    <t s="50">that the praises of Israel upon which the Holy One, blessed be He, sits and is sustained are the praises for His providing them with physical things</t>
    <t s="51">("for the health and sustenance that He, blessed be He, gives them"),</t>
    <t s="52">because in order for there to be a drawing down of the Essence of Ein Sof into physical matters, the praise must also be in these matters.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This is understood through the principle that the arousal from below must be in the likeness of the arousal from above it draws, as taught by the Maggid and the Zohar, and similarly, the drawing down of the Essence of Ein Sof through Israel's praises requires the praise to be in the specific matters where the drawing is to occur.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood according to the well-known58</t>
    <t s="2">matter of the arousal from above that is drawn down through the arousal from below,</t>
    <t s="3">for although that the arousal from below awakens and draws the arousal from above is not due to the virtue of the arousal from below itself, but because it so arose in His will, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="4">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="5">the arousal from below must be in the likeness of the arousal from above that is drawn down through it.</t>
    <t s="6">And according to the teaching of the Maggid59</t>
    <t s="7">on the verse60</t>
    <t s="8">"And upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man upon it from above,"</t>
    <t s="9">(for the explanation of "a likeness as the appearance of a man" is)</t>
    <t s="10">that according to the measure that a man shows from below, so they show him from above.</t>
    <t s="11">And it can be said</t>
    <t s="12">that the source of this matter is the statement of the Zohar61</t>
    <t s="13">"Come and see"</t>
    <t s="14">(that it is possible to see this with tangible sight)</t>
    <t s="15">etc.,</t>
    <t s="16">"If he stands in a cheerful countenance from below, then they illuminate him from above... the joy of a person draws to itself another supernal joy..."</t>
    <t s="17">And moreover,</t>
    <t s="18">that also this—that through man's service, matters are effected above62—</t>
    <t s="19">[is] according to the teaching of the Maggid63</t>
    <t s="20">on the Sages' statement64</t>
    <t s="21">"Know what is above from you,"</t>
    <t s="22">that everything that is above is all from you,</t>
    <t s="23">the service must be in the likeness of the matter above that is effected through it.</t>
    <t s="24">And it can be said</t>
    <t s="25">that similarly is it regarding the drawing down of the Essence of Ein Sof through the service of the praises of Israel,</t>
    <t s="26">for although regarding the drawing itself, it seemingly cannot be said that it is drawn through service65,</t>
    <t s="27">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="28">regarding the place where the drawing will be,</t>
    <t s="29">the service</t>
    <t s="30">(the praise)</t>
    <t s="31">must be in those matters in which the drawing will come.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>There are two aspects in the drawing down through Israel's praises: a general drawing down, called "sitting," and a drawing down in the manner of enclothing in a particular matter, called "sustenance," which connects the soul and body internally.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And one may add,</t>
    <t s="1">that in the drawing down through the praises of Israel,</t>
    <t s="2">there are two matters.</t>
    <t s="3">A general drawing down,</t>
    <t s="4">according to the explanation66</t>
    <t s="5">of "enthroned upon the praises of Israel," that through the praises of Israel He is drawn down below</t>
    <t s="6">[for the drawing down is called by the name "sitting,"</t>
    <t s="7">like one who sits, who lowers his stature],</t>
    <t s="8">a drawing down and revelation in general67</t>
    <t s="9">that is effected through</t>
    <t s="10">(the general matter of)</t>
    <t s="11">praise, from the term "when he caused to shine68</t>
    <t s="12">his lamp69,"</t>
    <t s="13">and the drawing down that is in the manner of enclothing in a particular matter</t>
    <t s="14">(through the praises of Israel being related to particular matters),</t>
    <t s="15">according to the explanation of the Baal Shem Tov on "enthroned upon the praises of Israel,"</t>
    <t s="16">that the praises of Israel are the sustenance of the Holy One, blessed be He, as it were, upon which He sits.</t>
    <t s="17">For the matter of sustenance is like sustenance in its simple sense, through which a connection of the soul with the body is made internally,</t>
    <t s="18">that the body lives from the soul.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
